therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: TLR7/8 agonism combined with IL-2 receptor activation and PD-1 checkpoint inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: immune system activation and T-cell stimulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with locally advanced/metastatic solid tumors including melanoma, Merkel cell carcinoma, triple negative breast cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, colorectal cancer, sarcoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: dose-limiting toxicities and objective response rate per RECIST 1.1

results.effect_size: ORR 0% (95% CI: 0.0-23.2) for doublet, ORR 14.3% (95% CI: 1.8-42.8) for triplet
subgroup_findings: triplet combination showed higher response rate than doublet
results.dose_information: NKTR-262 dose escalation from 0.03 mg to 3.84 mg intratumoral, bempegaldesleukin 0.006 mg/kg, nivolumab 360 mg flat dose, all in 3-week cycles

context.investigator_commentary: MTD of NKTR-262 was not reached with only 1 DLT occurring in highest dose cohort
